name: XSTABLE Protocol
fix_description: Remove the buy reward minting logic triggered by txType==1 in _implementBuy. The transfer hook cannot reliably distinguish swap from skim since both have sender=Pool, making any reward logic here exploitable.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step exploit involving a flash swap from one Uniswap V2 pair, manipulation of another pair’s reserves/balances using swap/sync/skim mechanics, then unwinding to repay the loan. It requires protocol-specific understanding of Uniswap V2 accounting and token/pair interactions, but the attack path is still fairly contained and not deeply cross-protocol or mathematically intricate.
